test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who has been appointed the Chairman of Staff Selection Commission (SSC) in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S. Kishore.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **S. Kishore** was appointed as the **Chairman of Staff Selection Commission **(SSC) on **February 1, 2022.**
 
• He succeeded **Braj Raj Sharma**, who completed his term as the Chairman on **January 31, 2022.**
 
• S. Kishore is an **Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer** of the **1988 batch **and was serving as the** Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax** in Mumbai before his appointment as the **Chairman of SSC.**
 
• The** Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** is a government organization that conducts various** recruitment exams** for **Group B and Group C posts **in various ministries and departments of the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rakesh Sharma** is a** former Indian Air Force (IAF) **pilot who became the first Indian to travel in space as a crew member of the **Soviet Union's Soyuz T-11 spacecraft in 1984.**
 
• **K. S. Mani **is a** retired Indian Police Service (IPS) officer** who served as the Director General of Police (DGP) of Kerala.
 
• **Vineet Joshi **is a** former Chairman** of the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** who is currently serving as the Director-General of the National Testing Agency (NTA).
